strings.notes: zh cry 咕啦咕啦 romanised (D-0025)

strings.zh: 呀~你好！{NEWLINE}哎呀~这真是令人震惊呢！{SCROLL}刚才的精灵是芳缘地区流传的{CLEAR}创世神话里出现的{CLEAR}盖欧卡！！{SCROLL}原来如此~原来如此~{SCROLL}这个埋没之塔是芳缘地方的人们{CLEAR}建造的东西啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Well, hello!{NEWLINE}Oh my, that was truly shocking!{SCROLL}That Pokémon was Kyogre, which{NEWLINE}appears in the creation myth handed{CLEAR}down in the Hoenn region!!{SCROLL}I see... I see.{SCROLL}So the Embedded Tower was built by the{NEWLINE}people of Hoenn.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0149/2; modernised from US 0149#2 | RV050: meaning: US rewrote; zh: shocking, creation myth of Hoenn

strings.zh: 如此说来⋯⋯？{SCROLL}连接海洋、陆地、天空的塔⋯⋯{SCROLL}在芳缘神话里出现的精灵并不只有{CLEAR}盖欧卡而已⋯⋯{SCROLL}关于此处还有很多地方不甚明朗,{CLEAR}仍然还留有谜团呢。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Which means...?{SCROLL}A tower that links the sea, the land,{NEWLINE}and the sky...{SCROLL}Kyogre was not the only Pokémon in the{NEWLINE}Hoenn myths...{SCROLL}There is still a lot about this place{NEWLINE}that’s unclear. Mysteries remain.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0149/3; modernised from US 0149#3 | RV050: omission: 如此说来⋯⋯？ dropped

strings.zh: 如果让博学的精灵博士{NEWLINE}看看盖欧卡的话,{CLEAR}或许会得到某些线索？{SCROLL}哎呀哎呀,{NEWLINE}精灵与神话的关系{CLEAR}还真是源远流长呢。{SCROLL}那么,{NEWLINE}下次在哪里再相见吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Maybe a knowledgeable Pokémon{NEWLINE}Professor could find some clues if you{CLEAR}showed them Kyogre?{SCROLL}My, my! Pokémon and myths really do go{NEWLINE}back a long way together.{SCROLL}Well then, until we meet{NEWLINE}again somewhere!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0149/4; modernised from US 0149#4 | RV050: meaning: US 'Phew!' and statement form; zh is a question, 源远流长
